Name: Janoah
Description: A town on Ephraim's border, named as the border passed eastward to Taanath-shiloh and on to Janohah — an Ephraimite border town, distinct from the northern Janoah taken by Tiglath-pileser.
BiblicalSignificance: Janoah appears only in the boundary description of Joshua 16, fixing Ephraim's northern edge; it is the southern Janoah, not the Naphtali town of 2 Kings 15.
